run_sample_coco: run the sample_coco script to generate images from COCO captions using a MetaQueryPipeline checkpoint
run_sample_metaquery: run sample_metaquery to generate images from text captions using a loaded MetaQueryPipeline
run_main_pipeline: run main to load a checkpoint, sample images from the COCO dataset, and save them to an output directory
review_sample_metaquery: review the sample_metaquery function that calls the MetaQueryPipeline with caption, guidance scale, and inference steps
review_main: review the main function that loads checkpoints, datasets, and batches image generation with configurable parameters
